There are some components of the dishwasher that I am concerned about, such as the plastic clasp that locks the door. I wonder how long that's gonna last before the cracks or breaks ? I find some of the tines that stack the dishes don't support dishes like our old dishwasher, the third top rack is super helpful as long as you don't have larger mugs or glasses because they hit the top of the dishwasher when you close it. I also should've chose a model without the controls on the top panel because we constantly hit them and have to cancel them out when you open the dishwasher, there should be a locking feature on the buttons to prevent, accidentally turning them on like my Samsung stove. We also noticed some streaking on glassware even using rinse aid, perhaps it's because I don't choose to dry them with heat, though we never used the heat feature on my old GE neither and didn't notice streaking ? I guess right now we'll have to see as we use the dishwasher more how it does, again I hate that it takes 2+ hrs. to wash dishes !

You can hear it run, but barely, and coming from a 15 year old Frigidaire to this one has been a world different. Last comment is on the 3rd rack, which the prior one did not have, I have found it very handy for all the miscellaneous items. The last unit had multiple items fall to the bottom and melt. Sentence (English): I recently purchased the Bosch 500 series dishwasher to replace a broken GE dishwasher we've had for 6 years.
Comments (English): [ What a difference a dishwasher makes! ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased the Bosch 500 series dishwasher to replace a broken GE dishwasher we've had for 6 years. I must say, it has completely transformed my daily routine. This dishwasher is a game-changer.The standout feature of this dishwasher is its remarkable quietness. Gone are the days of interrupting conversations or having to crank up the volume on the TV just to drown out the racket of a running dishwasher. This dishwasher operates at a near-silent level, allowing me to enjoy the peace and tranquility of my home while it efficiently tackles the day's dirty dishes. I love that there's a slight red light that illuminates the floor to let me know that it's on. But silence is not the only attribute that sets this dishwasher apart. Its drying capabilities are truly exceptional. I've tried many dishwashers in the past, and none have left my dishes as spotless and bone-dry as this. Whether it's delicate glassware or heavy-duty pots and pans, everything comes out immaculately dried and ready to be put away – no more tedious towel-drying or water spots to contend with.When it comes to the price, the Bosch 500 Series is worth every dollar invested. The quality and performance justify the initial cost, and the long-term savings on water and energy bills make it a smart financial choice. It's an investment in the comfort and convenience of your daily life, and one that pays off in more ways than one. No wonder this dishwasher was suggested by many online forums and kitchen appliance stores I've visited! The only thing I may think about a bit longer is whether paying extra for the handle bar would've been worth it. I used to hang my towels on there but now that this washer doesn't have a bar, it does look better but it's taken me a little longer to get used to. But it's certainly a minor issue. In conclusion, this dishwasher is a standout performer in the world of dishwashers. Its whisper-quiet operation and exceptional drying capabilities make it a top-tier choice for any household. You definitely get what you pay for. It's a purchase you won't regret.

Comments (English): [ Unimpressive for the Price ] || ---------------- || This is our third dishwasher (we've had GE and Electrolux). Furthermore, very little of the washing power makes it there, so our flatware came out with spots and sometimes with residual food if we didn't pre-clean well enough. The middle rack cannot be lowered, but if it could that would have prevented full-sized plates from fitting. We took out the top rack and are much happier. It is a little noisier than our Electrolux (which we referred to as the \"dish sanitizer\" because we had to thoroughly pre-clean), but does clean better on the bottom and middle racks. That said, you can get clean dishes for half the price. I don't understand the hype.

Sentence (English): Replaced a similar model that was only 11 years old and should have lasted longer.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Well but not Quality of Old Machines ] || ---------------- || Replaced a similar model that was only 11 years old and should have lasted longer. If our 20+ yr old Maytag in a rental house can still be problem free, you would expect a much higher priced Bosch to last longer than 11 yrs. But I am well aware that we love to ignore the technology that is available for making appliances last many years, and we love to send lots of very young appliances to the landfill. So I assumed no other brands would be any better. Plus I had generally been happy with the cleaning ability of the previous machine, so I purchased the similar model again. New one is noticeably lighter weight and missing some of the metal and insulation that surrounded the older one. The door is also flimsier, and there is now a floppy black vinyl strip above the toekick that sags enough to be seen from across a room. Even though the decibel rating is lower than the previous one, machine is louder. And you do have to always run on Heavy for decent cleaning. A definite disappointment is the placement of the buttons and timer on the top of the door so you can't see how much time is left when the machine is running. I can't imagine why a person would ever need to use her phone to run the dishwasher, but some of the cycle options can only be reached via the phone app. Also disappointing is the unnecessary rearrangement of the rack design to leave some strangely open space on the right side. (I did keep my old racks in case I can't figure out how to best use the new racks.). But. the machine does clean quite well without even rinsing the dishes first. It is an attractive design. The cycle does end with very wet dishes even with the Crystal Dry setting (even wetter than the previous model left them.) The third rack silverware holder is a repeat from older models and a very handy location for silverware and other small items. Love it! Meanwhile, you still have the option of a silverware basket if you prefer. Some of the flexible racks that can be laid down help to make the space very versatile! And even though the interior is smaller than other machines, it actually holds more dishes due to the closer tines. The sound is very quiet and works well in an open concept living area. Other than a Miele (which doesn't offer many repair options), this is probably the best you can do. It does clean well!

Sentence (English): Before my purchase, I spent many days researching for affordable, yet reliable and quiet dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Not as quiet as expected ] || ---------------- || Before my purchase, I spent many days researching for affordable, yet reliable and quiet dishwashers. Miele and Bosch seemed to be the most reliable (both are German brands so it seems plausable that their quality is superior) while Whirlpool seemed to come in on top for the remaining (American) brands. I was actually going to buy the Whirlpool because it had a matching handle that complimented the aesthetic of my existing oven, but the unit was out of stock at the Brick in Calgary. So, I opted for the Bosch 100 series instead. Now this is the bottom of the range of the Bosch line up (50dB noise rating) while other brands like Samsung offer a 44dB option in the same price range. But in the name of reliability, I went for Bosch. This one has a stainless steel tub liner but the bottom of the tub is plastic, contributing to the noise level. It also has no blanket on the outside, so I took the blanket off the outside of my old Bosch and used it on this new one prior to installation (and yet it is still fairly noisy). The 100 series is a plain Jane model. No 3rd rack, no adjustable top rack. But, it does have a Quick Cycle (60min) and an option to delay start and add extra drying time. It also has HomeComnect so you can control the unit via wifi and even download different types of wash cycles like Eco mode. Overall I am happy with the unit because it's a German product (although made in the USA) with supposed reliability, and widely available parts if it ever does crank out. The buying process at the Brick was great. The sales people were helpful and not pushy, not slimey. I would go back to the Brick for sure!

Sentence (English): The dishwasher itself works great and we're happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is great, install was a headache. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher itself works great and we're happy with it. It's very quiet and cleans great. Dishes don't have to be fully rinsed to still come out clean. I like the light that shines on the floor so you know when it's running. 3rd rack is useful for things like taller utensils, spatulas, small tupperware, and knives. The spacing of the tines on the bottom rack are a little slimmer than I'd like them to be so it can be difficult to get plates/bowls nestled in nicely. Not a huge deal though, as the silverware basket is removable if you need extra space. Install: The delivery and install was a nightmare. The dishwasher techs installed the wrong unit in our home and installed the unit we actually purchased at someone else's house. They had to come back and uninstall, go get our actual dishwasher, and then come back to reinstall. The unit we actually purchased didn't fit due to some old plumbing in the floor, so they left and kept trying to tell me to purchase the other one since it fit. We were able to adjust the plumbing issues on our own and a different tech came out a few days later and was able to install it, only to find out that the previous installers left some anchoring parts at the other house where our dishwasher was incorrectly installed. Overall the experience left a lot to be desired.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher was supposed to replace an old one that broke down a while ago.
Comments (English): [ Poor quality, had to return it ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher was supposed to replace an old one that broke down a while ago. When it was delivered, there was a problem right away. As the delivery man were wheeling it in, I noticed that water was dripping out of the package (that was outside on the way to my home). Inside, I guess they angled their trolley more and the water started pouring out. It was all over my floor. There was at least 1/2 gallon if not more. I know that it was no fault of the delivery man, but when I pointed put the water that spilled out, they seemed to be annoyed. One of them spoke some English and explained to me that the water was there as one cycle was run in the factory to make sure the dishwasher works. That was already a concern to me as it did not appear to drain water and should not have passed quality control. Next, I needed to install it (I was doing it myself). After unpacking it, I opened the door and was overwhelmed by the odor. It was very strong mix of plastic and detergent odor. I was wondering whether my dishes are going to have that odor after washing as I wouldn't be able to use them. Inside everything was wet. Even the manual and papers were wet. They were not drenched in water, but appeared that they were exposed to water for a long time and absorbed a lot of it. Pages were dark grey and felt wet to the touch. I carefully separated the pages of the manual so not to tear them and started installation. I don't remember the first step, but the second was to check whether the door was balanced. When opened by certain angle, it was supposed to fall flat on its own (it did), and when closed to about 20 degrees from the vertical it was supposed to snap shut on its own (it did not). I did some checking throughout the manual and the online. Problem is the spring and on this model spring tension cannot be adjusted. The only way was to change the spring. At this point, I thought that I would be a good idea to return it. Fortunately, Best Buy was good about it and arranged a pickup within a couple of days and processed my refund expeditiously. Maybe I have had a bad luck and got a defective one, but QC at GE should have picked that up. I am on the market for another one and it won't be GE.

A dishwasher, that I paid for, with Lowes installation, which never worked due to damage, not cause by me. will now be "no cost to me" (I already paid for it once and it did not work) all I have to do is pay to have it installed. AGAIN. THANK YOU SO MUCH LOWES. What a deal. I get a dishwasher, that I paid for and I get to pay for another instal. You are the best. I just love that for me. As a current property manager of of a 102 unit apartment in MT and properties in WA, I can promise you I will be reconsidering my Lowes Pro account. Thank you Lowes and LG for taking care of me. 10 out 10 Pass!

Comments (English): [ Unimpressive for the Price ] || ---------------- || This is our third dishwasher (we've had GE and Electrolux). We waited over a year to get this due to the supply chain issues around the pandemic, but I was assured that it would be worth it. After nine months with it, I am unconvinced. The third rack is a joke; it only fits silverware or a couple utensils but it takes up so much space that full-sized glasses don't fit on the middle rack and have to be placed on the bottom. Furthermore, very little of the washing power makes it there, so our flatware came out with spots and sometimes with residual food if we didn't pre-clean well enough. The middle rack cannot be lowered, but if it could that would have prevented full-sized plates from fitting. We took out the top rack and are much happier. It is a little noisier than our Electrolux (which we referred to as the "dish sanitizer" because we had to thoroughly pre-clean), but does clean better on the bottom and middle racks. That said, you can get clean dishes for half the price. I don't understand the hype.

Nothing disappointing, I just thought it would have blown me away as I was using an older, fairly bottom of the line GE dishwasher. The third rack and adjustable second rack are nice. I feel like the control buttons won't last very long. This dishwasher leaves a bunch of water (even the stainless door isn't dry) unless we use Finsih (and it seems to go through that stuff quickly). Some of it could be user error, as I'm still learning the settings. But I would think max dry would get things a bit dryer in there than it does.Overall, other than the fron control buttons, everything seems pretty solid. I just took one star because now have to buy Finish if I want my dishes to be fully dry.

Sentence (English): UPDATE 1/28/24: After my initial disappointment, I decided to get into the app and try to change settings there.
Comments (English): [ Cleans Well but not Quality of Old Machines ] || ---------------- || UPDATE 1/28/24: After my initial disappointment, I decided to get into the app and try to change settings there. Raising the dispensed amount of the rinse aid and changing the dry setting, the results are so much better! Dishes are dry when we are ready to put them away. Thank goodness! And the dishes are coming out cleaner even though I now only have to set them on "normal" rather than "heavy." Those two adjustments made a huge difference! ORIGINAL: Replaced a similar model that was only 11 years old and should have lasted longer. If our 20+ yr old Maytag in a rental house can still be problem free, you would expect a much higher priced Bosch to last longer than 11 yrs. But I am well aware that we love to ignore the technology that is available for making appliances last many years, and we love to send lots of very young appliances to the landfill. So I assumed no other brands would be any better. Plus I had generally been happy with the cleaning ability of the previous machine, so I purchased the similar model again. New one is noticeably lighter weight and missing some of the metal and insulation that surrounded the older one. The door is also flimsier, and there is now a floppy black vinyl strip above the toekick that sags enough to be seen from across a room. Even though the decibel rating is lower than the previous one, machine is louder. And you do have to always run on Heavy for decent cleaning. A definite disappointment is the placement of the buttons and timer on the top of the door so you can't see how much time is left when the machine is running. I can't imagine why a person would ever need to use her phone to run the dishwasher, but some of the cycle options can only be reached via the phone app. Also disappointing is the unnecessary rearrangement of the rack design to leave some strangely open space on the right side. (I did keep my old racks in case I can't figure out how to best use the new racks.) But. the machine does clean quite well without even rinsing the dishes first. It is an attractive design. The cycle does end with very wet dishes even with the Crystal Dry setting (even wetter than the previous model left them.) The third rack silverware holder is a repeat from older models and a very handy location for silverware and other small items. Love it! Meanwhile, you still have the option of a silverware basket if you prefer. Some of the flexible racks that can be laid down help to make the space very versatile! And even though the interior is smaller than other machines, it actually holds more dishes due to the closer tines. The sound is very quiet and works well in an open concept living area. Other than a Miele (which doesn't offer many repair options), this is probably the best you can do. It does clean well!

A definite disappointment is the placement of the buttons and timer on the top of the door so you can't see how much time is left when the machine is running. I can't imagine why a person would ever need to use her phone to run the dishwasher, but some of the cycle options can only be reached via the phone app. Also disappointing is the unnecessary rearrangement of the rack design to leave some strangely open space on the right side. (I did keep my old racks in case I can't figure out how to best use the new racks.) But...the machine does clean quite well without even rinsing the dishes first. It is an attractive design. The cycle does end with very wet dishes even with the Crystal Dry setting (even wetter than the previous model left them.) The third rack silverware holder is a repeat from older models and a very handy location for silverware and other small items. Love it! Meanwhile, you still have the option of a silverware basket if you prefer. Some of the flexible racks that can be laid down help to make the space very versatile! And even though the interior is smaller than other machines, it actually holds more dishes due to the closer tines. The sound is very quiet and works well in an open concept living area. Other than a Miele (which doesn't offer many repair options), this is probably the best you can do. It does clean well!

Comments (English): [ Poor quality, had to return it ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher was supposed to replace an old one that broke down a while ago. Inside, I guess they angled their trolley more and the water started pouring out. It was all over my floor. There was at least 1/2 gallon if not more. I know that it was no fault of the delivery man, but when I pointed put the water that spilled out, they seemed to be annoyed. One of them spoke some English and explained to me that the water was there as one cycle was run in the factory to make sure the dishwasher works. That was already a concern to me as it did not appear to drain water and should not have passed quality control. Next, I needed to install it (I was doing it myself). After unpacking it, I opened the door and was overwhelmed by the odor. It was very strong mix of plastic and detergent odor. I was wondering whether my dishes are going to have that odor after washing as I wouldn't be able to use them. Inside everything was wet. Even the manual and papers were wet. They were not drenched in water, but appeared that they were exposed to water for a long time and absorbed a lot of it. Pages were dark grey and felt wet to the touch. I carefully separated the pages of the manual so not to tear them and started installation. I don't remember the first step, but the second was to check whether the door was balanced. When opened by certain angle, it was supposed to fall flat on its own (it did), and when closed to about 20 degrees from the vertical it was supposed to snap shut on its own (it did not). I did some checking throughout the manual and the online. Problem is the spring and on this model spring tension cannot be adjusted. The only way was to change the spring. At this point, I thought that I would be a good idea to return it. Fortunately, Best Buy was good about it and arranged a pickup within a couple of days and processed my refund expeditiously.Maybe I have had a bad luck and got a defective one, but QC at GE should have picked that up. I am on the market for another one and it won't be GE.

I don't recommend this dishwasher or any Samsung dishwasher, unless you are willing to bite your own bullet when it breaks down!

I hope this review helps both me and you when making a purchase. :) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Product Name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-Place Capacity, DW30A3030CE (White), On-site Installation Product Capacity: 6-Place Capacity Product Weight: 21.5KG Purchase Price: Around 320,000 KRW If you keep it in your cart and check it often, the price sometimes drops suddenly. Set a bottom line and buy it right away when the price drops to a reasonable level! Pros: It's convenient! Need I say more! It cleans well! Cons: It feels like the noise is getting louder compared to when I first bought it? Overall Impression: Honestly, I used to think, "What's the point of a dishwasher? You can just wash dishes quickly by hand." Even though my previous home had an LG dishwasher, I didn't use it and just left it sitting there. However, while picking up trash in the neighborhood with my apartment residents, I must have picked it up with so much passion that my wrist started hurting terribly. I couldn't even wash dishes, and my wrist would tremble whenever I tried to do even slightly delicate work. I should have done it moderately. I regretted it. My wrist hurt so much that I thought, "I can't go on like this." While I was looking into buying a dishwasher, I was initially worried about the capacity. There were various sizes available—3-person, 6-person, and 12-person or larger. My sister's family has a 3-person model, and she complained that it was too small. However, since we are a family of three, I didn't think we needed a 12-person or larger one, and it would be too big. I wanted to place it on the kitchen counter and use it without having to bend over. So, while looking for a 6-person model, I thought, "It has to be Samsung," and ended up looking at Samsung dishwashers. For some reason, I just really like Samsung. But after the installation was complete, I realized it wasn't actually made by Samsung. I should have read the product details earlier. Two Samsung technicians came together to install it. Also, the dishwasher is quite large. I was surprised when it first arrived because it was bigger than I had expected. It looks like a 12-person dishwasher cut in half. Frying pans fit in easily. When I use it, I gather a day's worth of dishes and run the wash cycle all at once. Maybe it's because the amount of dishes in my house isn't much, but it really is perfect for home use. I am using it with great satisfaction. Make sure to look for it when the price is low. I definitely realized this time why they call it one of Korea's top three aunties. I think it is much better to have both a dryer and a dishwasher. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------. This appliance has absolutely changed my life, and has given me so much of my time back in cleaning. I would buy it a second time over. I have absolutely nothing bad to say about it. When we get a new home, we're taking it with us as a second dishwasher. I love this model, and would buy another GE fixed unit for our future home.

This was easily accomplished with my previous Bosch dishwasher which had a delay button and lasted for 20 years until the pump wore out. It is totally ridiculous to require users to use their phones to invoke a delay. Please engineer a simple delay feature on the control panel to eliminate the hassle of having to use my phone to accomplish this simple function. Otherwise I love the new dishwasher and am glad I purchased it,

Sentence (English): One day, I turned the dishwasher on, and in just a few minutes I started smelling like something was burning.
Comments (English): [ This dishwasher started a fire!  ] || ---------------- || One day, I turned the dishwasher on, and in just a few minutes I started smelling like something was burning. Tracked the smell to the dishwasher and noticed flames in the lower left corner. Called 911 immediately. The fire department came right away. Meanwhile, poured a couple of cups of water in that corner and the fire luckily went out. The firemen removed the dishwasher and stored it in my garage. There was no damage to any cabinetry. The only damage was on the dishwasher, where a piece of plastic was completely burnt and even made a hole all the way to the inside of the dishwasher! This indicated that the fire started in the dishwasher. The next day, I called Bosch and told them what happened. They opened a safety case and gave me the name of service providers to choose from, so that someone comes and assesses the situation. I picked a provider from the list and a technician came the next day. The technician confirmed that the fire must have started in the dishwasher, but could not tell how that happened since there are no electrical parts near that spot. He called Bosch and they asked him to send pictures and a report. He did that right in front of me. In the next two weeks, I called Bosch multiple times and their customer service would alternate their story between telling me that the service documentation is actually missing and they requested the service provider to send them over and that they already had everything and the case is being reviewed. Eventually, I wrote a rather angry email asking them to sort out their system. The next day, I received a call telling me that since I bought the dishwasher over a year ago, I should go through Lowe's (because, luckily, I bought the extended warranty). I argued that this is not a warranty case but a serious safety case. They said they understood, but I have to go through Lowe's anyway. I was amazed by how they did not care to figure out what caused the dishwasher to spontaneously start a fire and by how they strung me along for more than two weeks before they passed the responsibility onto Lowe's. The rest of the story is in fact positive: Lowe's protection plan worked as expected. They quickly had a technician come and deduce the exact same conclusion as the one from Bosch. But this time around, Lowe's concluded that the dishwasher needs to be replaced and they reimbursed me the full original price plus the installation fee. I am happy with the end of the story, but the new dishwasher is NOT from Bosch. After the scary incident and how I was treated, I cannot bring myself to trust Bosch products or their customer service. I would highly recommend to stay away from Bosch.

Sentence (English): I was thinking I'd be more impressed based on all the rave reviews I read before purchasing.
Comments (English): [ Okay ] || ---------------- || I was thinking I'd be more impressed based on all the rave reviews I read before purchasing. Nothing disappointing, I just thought it would have blown me away as I was using an older, fairly bottom of the line GE dishwasher. It is definitely quieter than our previous dishwasher, so much so that it's sometimes startling to hear the water draining as it's easy to forget it's on! The third rack and adjustable second rack are nice. I feel like the control buttons won't last very long. Hopefully they will, but I find myself having to press a few times to get a response, and the way they wiggle (hard to explain) makes them feel fragile. My old dishwasher had no problems drying completely (even plastics) without needing to add Finish. This dishwasher leaves a bunch of water (even the stainless door isn't dry) unless we use Finsih (and it seems to go through that stuff quickly). Some of it could be user error, as I'm still learning the settings. But I would think max dry would get things a bit dryer in there than it does. Overall, other than the fron control buttons, everything seems pretty solid. I just took one star because now have to buy Finish if I want my dishes to be fully dry.

Sentence (English): Good, but a bit disappointed in missing features.
Comments (English): [ Not what I hoped for as a visually impaired user. ] || ---------------- || Good, but a bit disappointed in missing features. I purchased an LG dishwasher because of the Wi-Fi capability. As a blind user, I had hoped to be able to control the dishwasher with my iPhone. I can only check what my settings are. The unit does its job, but is noisier than I would like. I wanted the larger model with more options, but was mistakenly told that that larger unit wouldn't fit. When the installer installed the unit, he told he the larger unit would have fit just fine. I had received incorrect information from the company who came to take measurements to see if I could use the larger model.The LGThinQ app is totally accessible by a blind user, but doesn't allow for one to select the cycles from the phone. I don't know whether a different model would have allowed for this. I also found that one could change the music on some LG appliances, but not on my model. Having this would have been a neat feature. Placing bump dots on the front of the unit just above the lights at least allows me to find and select the desired cycle. Had I not been given incorrect information as to whether the 34 inch models would have worked just fine, I would have bought one with more features hoping that I could have controlled it with my Iphone. I will say that if a blind user places bump dots on the front of the dishwasher, just above the lights, the unit is totally accessible. And the accessibility of the ThinQ app makes it easy to make sure that one has selected the desired settings. Every feature of the ThinQ app is completely accessible for a voiceover user. If there is no unit that a blind user can completely control from an iPhone, I would whole-heartedly recommend this dishwasher for a visually impaired user. It would be great if LG could have placed tactile dots above each light for easy cycle identification so that bump dots wouldn't have been necessary. I'd also like to see a firmware update allowing us to change the music as with the higher priced models. Also, would it be possible through firmware to allow this model to be controlled with an iPhone?

Sentence (English): We love our new Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Should Have Purchased Years Ago ] || ---------------- || We love our new Bosch dishwasher. It's the best purchase that we've made in a long time. Our old dishwasher (Kitchen Aid) just never quite lived up to our expectations to get the dishes -- especially glass ware and flatware as clean as we thought it should be and within a couple of years the silverware basket developed large holes in the bottom so we could only use it for spoons that wouldn't fall through the bottom. Comments (English): [ Poor product, and the WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE ] || ---------------- || Literally will never purchase another GE product. I bought the GE Profile dishwasher in April. So another technician came out a week later from another subcontracted company. When my wife told him the story that another company had already looked at the dishwasher, he immediately left. So after 3 weeks of not having a dishwasher, I called again to see if someone can help, I was told that the dishwasher was no longer under warranty. Asked to talk to a customer relations supervisor, Sabrina, who told me that someone must have ended the warranty, and she would send another technician out, this time, it would be an actual GE technician. I held for 55 minutes before April got on the phone. Spoke with April for 35 minutes hoping she would be able to do something else besides say there is nothing I can do. Probably the most frustrated I have ever been. April would answer after 30 second pauses, as if she was doing something else or not listening and would only repeat the same line, almost as she was reading from a page of responses that she had scripted. I was shocked at the unprofessionalism that a GE Customer Relation Supervisor exhibited. So after 2 months of waiting for someone to come out, the part is on back order and hoping it will arrive in February. If anyone from GE reads this review, there is an opportunity to improve education of your supervisors by listening to the call, as I asked if the calls are recorded, not believing that a GE employee was this unprofessional! I was told by April that the are. Never again.

Sentence (English): With kids around, I had to do the dishes as soon as I turned around.
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has changed. ] || ---------------- || With kids around, I had to do the dishes as soon as I turned around. As a result, I suffered from housewife's eczema. I had been putting off buying a mini dishwasher because I heard they don't hold many dishes. However, I decided to purchase it thinking it would be nice to at least wash cups. Now that it's installed, it looks big and I really like it. Also, since it disinfects, I don't have to disinfect the dishes separately. I just wash them once without detergent and put them in, and they come out cleaner and odor-free. When I used to wash them myself, greasy food containers would always feel slippery, but after putting them in the dishwasher, they come out squeaky clean. Now, I even regret not buying it sooner. Pros: 1. Saves time. I used to get stressed about the cups piling up after just a sip of water, but now I can put the dishes and cups in the dishwasher, run the robot vacuum, enjoy some free time, or go out, and when I come back, they are spotlessly clean. It is so convenient. 2. Space freedom. Because it is a mini size, I can install it in any space I want. I liked that I could coordinate with the installer, taking into account my movement flow in the kitchen, for the installation. 3. It is cheaper than a standard dishwasher. For around 300,000 won, you can enjoy convenience for 10 years. While standard dishwashers hold a lot of dishes, the drying performance was often lacking when stacked up to the second rack. However, since the mini size doesn't have water dripping from the top, I like the drying aspect as well. 4. It is quiet even when used in the early morning. I used to feel uncomfortable leaving dishes piled up in the sink to sleep because of the rattling noises from late-night snacks, and I would get annoyed when I woke up and had to do the dishes. But with this low-noise model, I can press the start button before falling asleep, and when I wake up, I see clean dishes, which makes me feel good right from the morning. 5. The operation time is short. It takes no more than 1 hour and 16 minutes, so on days with a lot of dishes, I can just wait a moment and run it twice. 6. I like that it is a Coupang Rocket Installation product, allowing for quick installation.

Sentence (English): Good, but a bit disappointed in missing features.
Comments (English): [ Not what I hoped for as a visually impaired user. ] || ---------------- || Good, but a bit disappointed in missing features. I purchased an LG dishwasher because of the Wi-Fi capability. As a blind user, I had hoped to be able to control the dishwasher with my iPhone. I can only check what my settings are. The unit does its job, but is noisier than I would like. I wanted the larger model with more options, but was mistakenly told that that larger unit wouldn't fit. When the installer installed the unit, he told he the larger unit would have fit just fine. I had received incorrect information from the company who came to take measurements to see if I could use the larger model. The LGThinQ app is totally accessible by a blind user, but doesn't allow for one to select the cycles from the phone. I don't know whether a different model would have allowed for this. I also found that one could change the music on some LG appliances, but not on my model. Having this would have been a neat feature. Placing bump dots on the front of the unit just above the lights at least allows me to find and select the desired cycle. Had I not been given incorrect information as to whether the 34 inch models would have worked just fine, I would have bought one with more features hoping that I could have controlled it with my Iphone. I will say that if a blind user places bump dots on the front of the dishwasher, just above the lights, the unit is totally accessible. And the accessibility of the ThinQ app makes it easy to make sure that one has selected the desired settings. Every feature of the ThinQ app is completely accessible for a voiceover user. If there is no unit that a blind user can completely control from an iPhone, I would whole-heartedly recommend this dishwasher for a visually impaired user. It would be great if LG could have placed tactile dots above each light for easy cycle identification so that bump dots wouldn't have been necessary. I'd also like to see a firmware update allowing us to change the music as with the higher priced models. Also, would it be possible through firmware to allow this model to be controlled with an iPhone?

Sentence (English): My spouse and I looked at so many dishwashers with all different options and prices.
Comments (English): [ Good Quality Good Price ] || ---------------- || My spouse and I looked at so many dishwashers with all different options and prices. We ended up going with the LG Top Control WI-FI Dishwasher with QuadWash Pro since it had everything we wanted; except a half load option which really is okay not to have. Our dishes come out clean and dry after a cycle. Plastic does not melt or get soft, that is great! It has three drawers with the top two adjustable. I love the very top drawer for small items and silverware, so when you need to remove the silverware compartment on the bottom drawer for more space. The top drawer on the far left side it can be adjust a bit. The second drawer is adjustable, which I love for plastic cups so they fit, get cleaned, but do not melt from the heating component at the bottom. Also the two main drawers have adjustable rack dividers which is super awesome when you need to wash say a large pot or bowls. Over all, this is a great dishwasher at an affordable price from a trusted appliance brand.

I asked if he could re-install the cheaper model so we would have a dishwasher to be able to host my family and friends through the holidays but he refused. He left, leaving a hole in my kitchen where a dishwasher should be. Best Buy now said they could install the correct dishwasher the following week. I have spent hours on the phone with Best Buy Customer Support for the past 6 weeks, pleading for support but it seems like my family is not a priority for their team. Also, if one isn't tech savvy, then one may not realize that there are "add-ons" that need to be downloaded in order to have full access to all functions of the dishwasher, when I believe that all functions should be available immediately out of the box. Sentence (English): The good: the machine operates so silently it's hard to tell if it's on!
Comments (English): [ Silent & Cleans Well ] || ---------------- || The good: the machine operates so silently it's hard to tell if it's on! Thankfully there's a light on the front that lets you know. So far it cleans wonderfully. With our old machine we had to practically wash the dishes by hand before putting them in the dishwasher. The separate silverware drawer (or for plastic lids or large utensils) is really great. Also, we purchased the white finish and that matches beautifully with our other white appliances. The confusing: as mentioned, the separate wash zones on the lower rack seem to require the app and mobile device to regulate and adjust. While this can be an advantage to some I prefer to be able to do all adjustments on the controls on the top of the door. The concerns: it's easy to turn on the machine when you open the door to put something inside. They are touch controls, no buttons, and in addition have a slight delay, causing you to press twice, which cancels the first action. Whereas the dishes come out dry and clean, there is often quite a bit of moisture inside tha machine that may be related to the "crystal" drying technology with this particular model. The aforementioned app is cumbersome. All in all, happy as a clam!

The installer rescheduled for 1/4 but never arrived, necessitating another call to Costco. Although the representative was helpful, the coordination between her, the third-party installer, etc., took about 45 minutes, and the installation date remains uncertain. Despite friendly and helpful customer service, the challenges arise from issues beyond Costco's control involving the manufacturer and the third-party installer.

Sentence (English): This review is mostly directed at Samsung's customer service and those they work with for fixing appliances.
Comments (English): [ Very Bad Customer Service ] || ---------------- || This review is mostly directed at Samsung's customer service and those they work with for fixing appliances. An issue came up with this dishwasher, which I bought roughly 2 years ago where it wouldn't complete a cycle and would beep and sounded like it was trying to run but wouldn't. I called Samsung's customer service to have a technician come out to fix the dishwasher. They said the dishwasher is out of warranty, and therefor I need to pay for the fix. First problem: your appliance products should probably last more than 2 years. We settled on Samsung paying for the parts and me paying for the labor. They connected me with a nearby service company, Moonrise, who was also terrible to work with; I needed to take work off to be home for the technician to show up, and this company kept trying to schedule the service last second, which didn't allow me enough time to notify my work. Finally after about 2 weeks of back and forth we got an appointment scheduled that worked. Of course it was too good to be true because the technician didn't show up and didn't call me to let me know they wouldn't be able to make it. When I contacted the company's office, they said they would look into it and never got back to me. After a couple more weeks of nothing from the company I called Samsung back, and they said the service company closed my ticket. So Samsung set me right back up with the same company for them to do the fix. The company comes out, looks into the issue with the dishwasher, tells me what's wrong, and then informs me that I need to pay a $120 diagnosis fee and that I need to give Samsung the OK for them to order the part and for the technician to come back out to do the fix another day. None of this was said to me by Samsung when I was on the phone with them or in any of their confirmation emails - they said the cost is $120 and that was for the fix to be done. So now I need to take a 3rd day off of work and pay more for the labor for this fix to happen. Nope - I'm done. I'll do it myself I guess.Up to you if you want to buy their products. They seem decent, but if something goes wrong you're probably going to have a nightmare of a time getting it fixed/resolved.

I called Samsung's customer service to have a technician come out to fix the dishwasher. They said the dishwasher is out of warranty, and therefor I need to pay for the fix. First problem: your appliance products should probably last more than 2 years. We settled on Samsung paying for the parts and me paying for the labor. They connected me with a nearby service company, Moonrise, who was also terrible to work with; I needed to take work off to be home for the technician to show up, and this company kept trying to schedule the service last second, which didn't allow me enough time to notify my work. Finally after about 2 weeks of back and forth we got an appointment scheduled that worked. Of course it was too good to be true because the technician didn't show up and didn't call me to let me know they wouldn't be able to make it. When I contacted the company's office, they said they would look into it and never got back to me. After a couple more weeks of nothing from the company I called Samsung back, and they said the service company closed my ticket. So Samsung set me right back up with the same company for them to do the fix. The company comes out, looks into the issue with the dishwasher, tells me what's wrong, and then informs me that I need to pay a $120 diagnosis fee and that I need to give Samsung the OK for them to order the part and for the technician to come back out to do the fix another day. None of this was said to me by Samsung when I was on the phone with them or in any of their confirmation emails - they said the cost is $120 and that was for the fix to be done. So now I need to take a 3rd day off of work and pay more for the labor for this fix to happen. Nope - I'm done. I'll do it myself I guess.Up to you if you want to buy their products. They seem decent, but if something goes wrong you're probably going to have a nightmare of a time getting it fixed/resolved.

Sentence (English): I bought a new Bosch series 8 dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought a new Bosch series 8 dishwasher. I had a narrow dishwasher (45 cm) which had been working for over 14 years and had never broken down. After moving in, we used a dishwasher from another manufacturer and were very dissatisfied with the quality of the work (periodically the machine would drain the water in the middle of the cycle and pump out the pathetic leftover water, as well as 'poor drying quality). So I decided to buy a machine from Bosch's higher range. I really like the quality of washing and drying. Even with normal drying, it dries very well, although a small amount of water remains on the plastic (on the deep lids) (and this is much less than on the previous dishwasher from another manufacturer ). All the moisture inside the plastic jars is gone, and this is also what sets the Bosch dishwasher apart. The machine is quite quiet, compared to other machines I've had, it's twice as quiet, even on a normal program. The backlight of the washing chamber is of course a nice bonus (as in the Bosch 6 series washing machine and dryer, which I already have), although it is not very convenient to comfortably charge the machine in the dark, however, it is much better with than without. Very easy to follow instructions for installation into the kitchen unit. There are QR codes for almost every illustration, which allow you to download the corresponding video at that stage of the installation. It's really super. I was pleasantly surprised! Easy adjustment of the height of the rear legs from the front panel (a big step forward compared to other Bosch freestanding dishwashers with built-in option - it is not possible to adjust the rear legs when the appliance is already inserted in the kitchen cabinet). I haven't yet appreciated all the benefits of connecting to Home Connect, it takes time, but in general it is convenient. I really like the graphic screen. It was he who won me over and it was only because of him that I decided to take a dishwasher of the 8th series, and not the 6th. I saw a comment somewhere that says that you need to buy a set of top brackets, because without them it is impossible to install it and I myself bought the same set, because it is not in the kit. After studying the instructions, I realized that these brackets are not really needed, since the machine is attached to the side walls using special bushings, which are included in the kit. I highly recommend purchasing this machine! Although the machine is expensive, the money is definitely worth it. In general, what I would like to say about Bosch devices is that it is a very good, stable brand with stable quality. When you buy this device, you get exactly what you expect, with no surprises. I have owned a Bosch Silence Plus dishwasher, a Bosch WLM20440 washing machine, a Bosch food processor, and more recently a Serenity series 6 washer and dryer. Always positive emotions and a quality product that we Don't even think about the cost. When installing this machine, a slight inconvenience was noticed in the design of the side panels of the front door (when installing the facade plates pressed by the facade, slightly separated on the sides, but the problem is minimal and solved in 3 minutes). I won't dispute that there are more expensive brands offering slightly better features, but as I mentioned above, Bosch devices are definitely worth the price. The quality of materials and workmanship is absolutely predictable, and reliability is very high.
Comments (Original): [ Bon lave-vaisselle ] || ---------------- || J'ai acheté un nouveau lave-vaisselle Bosch série 8. J'avais un lave-vaisselle étroit (45 cm) qui fonctionnait depuis plus de 14 ans et n'était jamais tombé en panne. Après avoir emménagé, nous avons utilisé un lave-vaisselle d'un autre fabricant et avons été très insatisfaits de la qualité du travail (périodiquement, la machine vidait l'eau au milieu du cycle et pompait les minables restes d'eau, ainsi qu'une mauvaise qualité de séchage). J'ai donc décidé d'acheter une machine de la gamme supérieure de Bosch.J'aime beaucoup la qualité de lavage et de séchage. Même avec un séchage normal, il sèche très bien, bien qu'il reste une petite quantité d'eau sur le plastique (sur les couvercles profonds) (et c'est beaucoup moins que sur le lave-vaisselle précédent d'un autre fabricant). Comments (English): [ Cleans Like a Champ ] || ---------------- || There are a number of things I really like about the Bosch 800 dishwasher:1. It really does a great job of cleaning. Even then, it is very quiet.3. Faster than expected. Our prior washer would take 3+ hours to clean a load of dishes. This one does a better job in slightly less than two hours.4. Dishes and glassware are generally very dry. The proprietary drying system isn't perfect, but its better than any other dishwasher we've owned and I rarely get the huge plume of steam when I open the dishwasher at the end of the cycle.5. The interior of the dishwasher is laid out efficiently. It took awhile to figure out the best placement for small and large plates, and regular and mixing bowls, but once I did, this dishwasher can hold an amazing amout of dishes. Keeping up with the dishes is critical when we have a packed house.I do have one quibble. The utinsel basket is too small. It almost always gets filled up before we have enough other things that need washing. I'll probably grab the basket from the old dishwasher and use it.

The absorption type is nice. I was tired of filling the water in my old dishwasher. So I cleaned it up and washed the dishes, but I didn't notice much of a difference. The absorption type has a convenient foldable water tank, and I like the 10L pickling tank, like mine. I think a dishwasher that's easy to put in spoons and chopsticks and doesn't require worrying about filling it with water is a good buy. If it had an automatic cleaning function, it would be worth the investment. Easy cleaning and maintenance would be good, too. It seems like the storage function needs a separate button. Sentence (English): This is an honest review based on my own purchase!
Comments (English): [ Don't hesitate, just go! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review based on my own purchase! I wrote this after using it for 3 months. ----------Reason for Purchase----------. I bought this thinking, "Once the second child is born, it will be too much to do the dishes while taking care of the first one! Let's use that time to play with the kids!" A friend who already uses a dishwasher also highly recommended it! ----------Pros----------. If you arrange the dishes well like Tetris, they come out much cleaner than when I do the dishes myself! They say it saves water too, so it's killing two birds with one stone! Plus, I like that I can spend time with the babies instead of doing the dishes! ~. The most important part is! It seems you can stop the dishwasher midway and add any dishes you forgot! ~. This is actually quite good. You know how sometimes you forget laundry and have to put it back in at the beginning? ~ It’s exactly like that. Good good. Also, I like that the door opens automatically after the washing is finished! With two kids, it’s chaotic, so it’s impossible to pay attention to opening the door as well. ----------Cons----------. It depends on the situation, but if you have a young baby, it's best to time the run carefully! The sound of the water draining is surprisingly loud! It makes a whooshing sound, and sometimes the baby gets startled when they are half-asleep. We don't run it when it's quiet. Other than that, there isn't really anything to complain about. It doesn't even bother me when there is everyday noise! It's not really a downside. ----------Purchase Review----------. This is a review written after using it for nearly 3 months! First of all, my quality of life has changed! My second child goes to bed early, so after dinner, I wash them and put them to sleep right away. It used to be annoying when there were piles of dishes in the morning. Now, I don't have that stress anymore! Even if there are piles in the morning, I can just quickly throw them in and run it! Are you agonizing over which product to choose while reading reviews? I was too! This is the dishwasher I finally chose, and I'm happy with it! Prices can fluctuate significantly, with a difference of up to 50,000 to 100,000 won, so add it to your cart and grab it when it's on the low price! With the card discount, it was 33 for us! ~ Without the card discount, it was 36! Don't hesitate, just get it! ^^. It's Samsung, everyone!

Keeping up with the dishes is critical when we have a packed house. I do have one quibble. The utinsel basket is too small. It almost always gets filled up before we have enough other things that need washing. I'll probably grab the basket from the old dishwasher and use it.

Sentence (English): Great dishwasher except for the undersized soap container.
Comments (English): [ Outstanding except for a couple of things ] || ---------------- || Great dishwasher except for the undersized soap container. The Kirkland pods we use sometimes keep the soap door from opening completely, so there is still detergent on the door and the dishes, necessitating an additional rinse cycle. We have found that we have too insert the pods in a special orientation in order to eliminate the problem. Also, we find that the "hump" running lengthwise along the two side slots of the middle tray are way too high, thus preventing placing some items, like bowls which collect and hold water because they are tipped to far back. We do appreciate the quietness, but we're surprised at how long the cycles take. But everything comes out super clean.

Sentence (English): I compared it with a Coupang product in a similar price range, but I figured a product from a major brand would be better, so I decided to buy this one, and I think I made the right choice.
Comments (English): [ 6-person dishwasher that helps you live ] || ---------------- || I compared it with a Coupang product in a similar price range, but I figured a product from a major brand would be better, so I decided to buy this one, and I think I made the right choice. The biggest factor in switching to Samsung was that the product I was comparing it to didn't have a stainless steel top interior. Although some other features were lacking, I figured as long as it fulfills the basics, the interior finish is more important. Since our family of four mostly gathers for dinner, we don't generate a huge amount of dishes, so the 6-person capacity is sufficient. It is difficult to fit large cooking utensils in together, but you can fit a frying pan or a pot along with plates, bowls, cooking tools, and water cups. You can simply hand-wash large pots, pans, and bowls, and just put the smaller items in the washing machine. It is sufficient if you think of the 6-person capacity as providing assistance rather than doing everything for you. Even so, thanks to this dishwasher, the time spent washing dishes in the kitchen has been cut by more than half. Not only has the time been saved, but the quality of the dishwashing is also excellent. It really lifts my spirits when the dishes and spoons come out sparkling clean. I use half or a quarter of the solid detergent packet. I use rinse aid as well, but it consumes a lot of it. One downside of this product is that you can't run just the rinse cycle again. That seems to be why the newly released model includes an extra rinse option. Other than that, I am very satisfied with it. I didn't realize how convenient it was until I had one, but having it is truly great. I think a dishwasher is a must-have.
Comments (Original): [ 생활의 도움을 주는 6인용 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 비슷한 가격대 쿠*제품과 비교 하다가 그래도 대기업제품이 더 났겠지 싶어 구매했는데 잘 한것 같아요. 비교하던 제품이 내부 윗면이 스텐이 아니어서 삼성으로 넘어온게 제일 컸어요. 다른 기능들이 아쉽긴 했지만 어차피 기본만 충실하면 되고 내부 마감이 더 중요하니까요. 일단 저희는 4식구가 저녁에만 다 모여 식사하는일이 많은데 그렇게 설겆이가 많이 나오질 않아서 6인용으로도 충분하네요. 요리용 도구 중 좀 큰것들은 같이 넣기 힘들지만 후라이팬 하나 아니면 냄비 정도 하나는 같이 넣고 접시 밥그릇 조리도구, 물컵 등 넣고 돌릴 수 있어요. 큰 냄비, 후라이팬, 큰볼 이런것들은 손으로 하고 작은것들만 넿고 돌린다고 생각하면 충분해요. 6인용은 다 해주는게 아니라 도움을 준다정도로 생각하시면 좋을것 같아요.그래도 이 식세기 때문에 주방에서 설겆이 하는 시간이 반 이상 줄었어요.일단 시간도 줄어들긴 했지만,  식세기의 설겆이 퀄리티가 아주 좋아요. 그릇이며, 숟가락등이 아주 반짝반짝 해 져서 나오면 기분까지 좋아져요.세제는 고체형 제품 반이나 1/4로 나누어서 사용 하고 있어요. 린스도 같이 사용하는데 린스를 많이 잡아먹어요 ㅎㅎ이제품 사용 하면서 한가지 아쉬운점은 헹굼만 다시 할수 없는점 입니다. 그래서 새로 출시한거에는 헹굼추가가 생긴것 같아요. 이것 외에는 아주 만족하고 쓰고 있어요. 없을땐 몰랐지만 있으니 아주 편하고 좋네요. 식기세척기는 필수? 인것 같아요

Sentence (English): We received our dishwasher within the time window Home Depot shared the day before.
Comments (English): We received our dishwasher within the time window Home Depot shared the day before. We installed the dishwasher on our own and in all it took my husband and I around 3 hours to install. Many parts of the installation went smoothly. We were surprised that the power cord needed to be completely connected with the wire nuts as we thought this small part could have been previously installed. We've had the dishwasher for a month now and it runs smoothly. It's fairly quiet and I love the light on the front that changes from orange to white to show the cycle is complete, very helpful! We love the bottle jets and are hoping the plastic interior tub holds up throughout the years. When running the dry on normal boost I will say the dishes are not always dry. We haven't tried the high dry boost yet but I may need to if our dishes keep coming out wet (mostly with cups and mugs that have a small dip in the top). Overall we're happy with our dishwasher and would recommend to friends if they would like a cheaper but efficient option!

Sentence (English): We first bought a BOSCH without realizing that it had no heated air dry function or even a vent.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well. Loads Poorly. ] || ---------------- || We first bought a BOSCH without realizing that it had no heated air dry function or even a vent. We returned that and bought this KitchenAid. It cleans well and drys acceptably. BUT the racks are not designed to hold glassware and cups securely. they can fly around and break. Plus, yes it has three racks but the clearance is very tight and it's easy to bang dishes and glassware into the rack above or the roof. And the bottom rack doesn't handle bowls (even cereal bowls) well. the spaces are too small. We've removed what (prongs) we can to get more space but you can't load nearly as many dishes as you'd expect, nor as many as our previous KitchenAid could handle. Also note that this has no "light wash" or "rinse" functions. Look carefully and you'll see that the "Express Wash" is designed to work fast. not "lightly" and it takes twice as much water as the Normal mode. Also, there's not a serious manual available that really explains what each mode does and how. The BOSCH had a real manual. And when I wanted to register a complaint higher up in the food chain at KitchenAid customer support told me that I could not. I could only complain to them. So we're keeping this but I grind my teeth every time I have to load it. Oh. and the advertising shows large glasses laid on an angle in the top rack. no way. the clearance doesn't allow that.
